.arg(blocker)\n            .arg(\"--blocks\")\n            .arg(blocked)\n            .output()\n            .expect(\"Failed to execute bf dep add\");\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            panic!(\n                \"Failed to add dependency: {}\",\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Claim a bead for testing\n    pub fn claim_bead(assignee: &str) -> String {\n        let output = super::bf_command()\n            .arg(\"claim\")\n            .arg(\"--assignee\")\n            .arg(assignee)\n            .output()\n            .expect(\"Failed to execute bf claim\");\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            panic!(\n                \"Failed to claim bead: {}\",\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)\n            );\n        }\n\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n        // Extract bead_id from JSON output\n        let json = super::json_validation::parse_json(&stdout);\n        super::json_validation::get_string(&json, \"bead_id\")\n    }\n}\n\n/// Format detection and validation helpers\npub mod format_detection {\n    use super::json_validation::*;\n\n    /// JSON output format types\n    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\n    pub enum JsonFormat {\n        /// Single JSON object (e.g., `{\"key\": \"value\"}`)\n        SingleObject,\n        /// JSON array (e.g., `[{\"key\": \"value\"}]`)\n        Array,\n        /// JSONL - newline-delimited JSON (e.g., `{\"key\": \"value\"}\\n{\"key2\": \"value2\"}`)\n        JsonL,\n        /// Empty array (`[]`)\n        EmptyArray,\n        /// Empty string (no output)\n        Empty,\n    }\n\n    /// Detect the format of JSON output\n    pub fn detect_format(output: &str) -> JsonFormat {\n        let trimmed = output.trim();\n\n        if trimmed.is_empty() {\n            return JsonFormat::Empty;\n        }\n\n        if trimmed == \"[]\" {\n            return JsonFormat::EmptyArray;\n        }\n\n        // Check if it's a JSONL (multiple lines)\n        let lines: Vec<&str> = trimmed.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).collect();\n\n        if lines.len() > 1 {\n            // Verify each line is valid JSON\n            for line in lines {\n                parse_json(line);\n            }\n            return JsonFormat::JsonL;\n        }\n\n        // Single line - check if it's an array or object\n        let parsed = parse_json(trimmed);\n\n        if parsed.is_array() {\n            JsonFormat::Array\n        } else if parsed.is_object() {\n            JsonFormat::SingleObject\n        } else {\n            panic!(\"Unexpected JSON format: {}\", trimmed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Assert that output is in the expected format\n    pub fn assert_format(output: &str, expected: JsonFormat) {\n        let detected = detect_format(output);\n        assert_eq!(\n            detected, expected,\n            \"Format mismatch: expected {:?}, got {:?}\",\n            expected, detected\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// Check if output is valid JSONL (may be empty)\n    pub fn is_valid_jsonl(output: &str) -> bool {\n        let trimmed = output.trim();\n\n        if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed == \"[]\" {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        // Try to parse each line as JSON\n        for line in trimmed.lines() {\n            if !line.trim().is_empty() {\n                if try_parse_json(line).is_err() {\n                    return false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Check if output is a valid JSON object\n    pub fn is_valid_json_object(output: &str) -> bool {\n        let trimmed = output.trim();\n        if trimmed.is_empty() {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        match try_parse_json(trimmed) {\n            Ok(v) => v.is_object(),\n            Err(_) => false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Check if output is a valid JSON array\n    pub fn is_valid_json_array(output: &str) -> bool {\n        let trimmed = output.trim();\n        if trimmed.is_empty() {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        match try_parse_json(trimmed) {\n            Ok(v) => v.is_array(),\n            Err(_) => false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Envelope wrapping validation helpers\npub mod envelope {\n    use super::json_validation::*;\n    use serde_json::Value;\n\n    /// Expected envelope structure: {version: 1, kind: \"<command>\", data: <payload>}\n    pub fn validate_envelope(json: &str, expected_kind: &str) -> Value {\n        let envelope = parse_json(json);\n\n        // Check version field\n        let version = envelope.get(\"version\")\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_i64())\n            .expect(\"Envelope must have numeric 'version' field\");\n        assert_eq!(version, 1, \"Envelope version must be 1\");\n\n        // Check kind field\n        let kind = envelope.get(\"kind\")\n            .and_then(|k| k.as_str())\n            .expect(\"Envelope must have string 'kind' field\");\n        assert_eq!(kind, expected_kind, \"Envelope kind mismatch\");\n\n        // Check data field exists\n        assert!(\n            envelope.get(\"data\").is_some(),\n            \"Envelope must have 'data' field\"\n        );\n\n        envelope\n    }\n\n    /// Get the data field from an envelope\n    pub fn get_envelope_data(envelope: &Value) -> Value {\n        envelope.get(\"data\")\n            .cloned()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!(\"Envelope missing 'data' field\"))\n    }\n\n    /// Check if envelope has a warning field\n    pub fn has_warning(envelope: &Value) -> bool {\n        envelope.get(\"warning\").is_some()\n    }\n\n    /// Get warning from envelope if present\n    pub fn get_warning(envelope: &Value) -> Option<String> {\n        envelope.get(\"warning\")\n            .and_then(|w| w.as_str())\n            .map(|s| s.to_string())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Command output capture helpers\npub mod capture {\n    use std::process::Command;\n\n    /// Capture stdout from a command as a string\n    pub fn capture_stdout(cmd: &mut Command) -> String {\n        let output = cmd.output().expect(\"Failed to execute command\");\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            panic!(\n                \"Command failed: {}\\nStderr: {}\",\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)\n            );\n        }\n\n        String::from_utf8(output.stdout).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\")\n    }\n\n    /// Capture stderr from a command as a string\n    pub fn capture_stderr(cmd: &mut Command) -> String {\n        let output = cmd.output().expect(\"Failed to execute command\");\n        String::from_utf8(output.stderr).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\")\n    }\n\n    /// Capture both stdout and stderr from a command\n    pub fn capture_both(cmd: &mut Command) -> (String, String) {\n        let output = cmd.output().expect(\"Failed to execute command\");\n\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8(output.stderr).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            panic!(\"Command failed.\\nStdout: {}\\nStderr: {}\", stdout, stderr);\n        }\n\n        (stdout, stderr)\n    }\n\n    /// Capture command output even when it fails (doesn't panic on error)\n    pub fn capture_failed_command(cmd: &mut Command) -> (String, String, bool) {\n        let output = cmd.output().expect(\"Failed to execute command\");\n\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8(output.stderr).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n        let success = output.status.success();\n\n        (stdout, stderr, success)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod infrastructure_tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use super::json_validation::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_workspace_creation() {\n        let from_str(json).unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n88\t            panic!(\"Failed to parse JSON: {}\\nJSON was: {}\", e, json)\n89\t        })\n90\t    }\n91\t\n92\t    /// Parse a JSONL string (newline-delimited   .map(|line| parse_json(line))\n98\t            .collect()\n99\t    }\n100\t\n101\t    /// Assert that a JSON string is valid\n102\t    pub fn assert_valid_json(json: &str) {\n103\t        parse_json(json);\n104\t    }\n105\t\n106\t    /// Check if JSON has a specific field\n107\t    pub fn has_field(json: &Value, field: &str) -> bool {\n108\t        json.get(field).is_some()\n109\t    }\n110\t\n111\t    /// Get a string field from JSON, panic if missing or not a string\n112\t    pub fn get_string(json: &Value, field: &str) -> String {\n113\t        json.get(field)\n114\t            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n115\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!(\"Field '{}' is not a string or is missing: {}\", field, json))\n116\t            .to_string()\n117\t    }\n118\t}\n119\t\n120\t/// Envelope validation helpers\n121\tmod envelope {\n122\t    use super::json_validation::*;\n123\t    use serde_json::Value;\n124\t\n125\t    /// Expected envelope structure: {version: 1, kind: \"<command>\", data: <payload>}\n126\t    pub fn validate_envelope(json: &str, expected_kind: &str) -> Value {\n127\t        let envelope = parse_json(json);\n128\t\n129\t        // Check version field\n130\t        let version = envelope.get(\"version\")\n131\t            .and_then(|v| v.as_i64())\n132\t            .expect(\"Envelope must have numeric 'version' field\");\n133\t        assert_eq!(version, 1, \"Envelope version must be 1\");\n134\t\n135\t        // Check kind field\n136\t        let kind = envelope.get(\"kind\")\n137\t            .and_then(|k| k.as_str())\n138\t            .expect(\"Envelope must have string 'kind' field\");\n139\t        assert_eq!(kind, expected_kind, \"Envelope kind mismatch\");\n140\t\n141\t        // Check data field exists\n142\t        assert!(\n143\t            envelope.get(\"data\").is_some(),\n144\t            \"Envelope must have 'data' field\"\n145\t        );\n146\t\n147\t        envelope\n148\t    }\n149\t\n150\t    /// Get the data field from an envelope\n151\t    pub fn get_envelope_data(envelope: &Value) -> Value {\n152\t        envelope.get(\"data\")\n153\t            .cloned()\n154\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!(\"Envelope missing 'data' field\"))\n155\t    }\n156\t}\n157\t\n158\t/// Helper to run `bf list --json` and return stdout\n159\tfn run_list_json(workspace: &Path) ->  if trimmed == \"[]\" {\n            return JsonFormat::EmptyArray;\n        }\n\n        // Check if it's a JSONL (multiple lines)\n        let lines: Vec<&str> = trimmed.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).collect();\n\n        if lines.len() > 1 {\n            // Verify each line is valid JSON\n            for line in lines {\n                parse_json(line);\n            }\n            return JsonFormat::JsonL;\n        }\n\n        // Single line - check if it's an array or object\n        let parsed = parse_json(trimmed);\n\n        if parsed.is_array() {\n            JsonFormat::Array\n        } else if parsed.is_object() {\n            JsonFormat::SingleObject\n        } else {\n            panic!(\"Unexpected JSON format: {}\", trimmed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Assert that output is in the expected format\n    pub fn assert_format(output: &str, expected: JsonFormat) {\n        let detected = detect_format(output);\n        assert_eq!(\n            detected, expected,\n            \"Format mismatch: expected {:?}, got {:?}\",\n            expected, detected\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// Check if output is valid JSONL (may be empty)\n    pub fn is_valid_jsonl(output: &str) -> bool {\n        let trimmed = output.trim();\n\n        if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed == \"[]\" {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        // Try to parse each line as JSON\n        for line in trimmed.lines() {\n            if !line.trim().is_empty() {\n                if try_parse_json(line).is_err() {\n                    return false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Check if output is a valid JSON object\n    pub fn is_valid_json_object(output: &str) -> bool {\n        let trimmed = output.trim();\n        if trimmed.is_empty() {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        match try_parse_json(trimmed) {\n            Ok(v) => v.is_object(),\n            Err(_) => false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Check if output is a valid JSON array\n    pub fn is_valid_json_array(output: &str) -> bool {\n        let trimmed = output.trim();\n        if trimmed.is_empty() {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        match try_parse_json(trimmed) {\n            Ok(v) => v.is_array(),\n            Err(_) => false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Envelope wrapping validation helpers\npub mod envelope {\n    use super::json_validation::*;\n    use serde_json::Value;\n\n    /// Expected envelope structure: {version: 1, kind: \"<command>\", data: <payload>}\n    pub fn validate_envelope(json: &str, expected_kind: &str) -> Value {\n        let envelope = parse_json(json);\n\n        // Check version field\n        let version = envelope.get(\"version\")\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_i64())\n            .expect(\"Envelope must have numeric 'version' field\");\n        assert_eq!(version, 1, \"Envelope version must be 1\");\n\n        // Check kind field\n        let kind = envelope.get(\"kind\")\n            .and_then(|k| k.as_str())\n            .expect(\"Envelope must have string 'kind' field\");\n        assert_eq!(kind, expected_kind, \"Envelope kind mismatch\");\n\n        // Check data field exists\n        assert!(\n            envelope.get(\"data\").is_some(),\n            \"Envelope must have 'data' field\"\n        );\n\n        envelope\n    }\n\n    /// Get the data field from an envelope\n    pub fn get_envelope_data(envelope: &Value) -> Value {\n        envelope.get(\"data\")\n            .cloned()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!(\"Envelope missing 'data' field\"))\n    }\n\n    /// Check if envelope has a warning field\n    pub fn has_warning(envelope: &Value) -> bool {\n        envelope.get(\"warning\").is_some()\n    }\n\n    /// Get warning from envelope if present\n    pub fn get_warning(envelope: &Value) -> Option<String> {\n        envelope.get(\"warning\")\n            .and_then(|w| w.as_str())\n            .map(|s| s.to_string())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Command output capture helpers\npub mod capture {\n    use std::process::Command;\n\n    /// Capture stdout from a command as a string\n    pub fn capture_stdout(cmd: &mut Command) -> String {\n        let output = cmd.output().expect(\"Failed to execute command\");\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            panic!(\n                \"Command failed: {}\\nStderr: {}\",\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)\n            );\n        }\n\n        String::from_utf8(output.stdout).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\")\n    }\n\n    /// Capture stderr from a command as a string\n    pub fn capture_stderr(cmd: &mut Command) -> String {\n        let output = cmd.output().expect(\"Failed to execute command\");\n        String::from_utf8(output.stderr).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\")\n    }\n\n    /// Capture both stdout and stderr from a command\n    pub fn capture_both(cmd: &mut Command) -> (String, String) {\n        let output = cmd.output().expect(\"Failed to execute command\");\n\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8(output.stderr).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            panic!(\"Command failed.\\nStdout: {}\\nStderr: {}\", stdout, stderr);\n        }\n\n        (stdout, stderr)\n    }\n\n    /// Capture command output even when it fails (doesn't panic on error)\n    pub fn capture_failed_command(cmd: &mut Command) -> (String, String, bool) {\n        let output = cmd.output().expect(\"Failed to execute command\");\n\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8(output.stderr).expect(\"Invalid UTF-8\");\n        let success = output.status.success();\n\n        (stdout, stderr, success)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod infrastructure_tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use super::json_validation::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_workspace_creation() {\n        let
